Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow file under `.github/workflows/` (please name it) (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script/helper file under `scripts/` (please name it) (RECOMMENDED)
C. Repo documentation only (`README.md`, runbooks, or similar)
D. A broader pipeline phase (clarify / plan / implement / review / orchestrate / validate), and the agent should identify the exact files
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or broken behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a new capability
C. Improve reliability/safety without changing user-facing behavior
D. Improve readability/maintainability only
Q3. How should success be judged for this issue?
Choices:
A. Match a specific expected behavior/output you describe (RECOMMENDED)
B. Resolve a known failure message, log symptom, or flaky workflow run
C. Apply a general cleanup/refinement in the named area, using conservative defaults if no exact bug is known
